build_notes: If passed: total manpower of all units (incl. fielded) <= 5% of nation population; block recruiting past it and show the cap on the military page. Existing armies above the cap are kept, just can't grow.
detail: Chel's suggestion: e.g. 5% of your population can be soldiers in total.
title: Should army size be capped by population, with troops already in the field counting toward the cap?
